headline: Fronts Surge as Bases Trade Hands
war_summary: Since the last edition three hours ago the bloodiest corridors have intensified. Nevish Line now leads the theater with 46 ownership changes in the past day and casualty rates climbing sharply for both sides — Colonial losses near 6,200 and Warden losses near 6,800. Callahans Passage follows with 29 flips and roughly 11,000 Colonial and 12,000 Warden dead, while Weathered Expanse records 27 exchanges and a combined toll exceeding 17,000. Palantine Berm, though still active with 36 flips, shows its short‑term casualty rates beginning to cool. Kuura Strand has surged to 24 events with a sudden spike of 227 Colonial and 46 Warden casualties in the last two hours, and enlistments accelerating on both fronts. Stlican Shelf adds 15 flips with casualties rising modestly. Across the remaining sectors the map is largely static; most regions remain wholly held by a single faction with only low‑level attrition and no ownership activity reported.
